channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US intercepts Iranian attacks as Israel continues to bomb Lebanon
item.description: US Central Command said seven ballistic missiles were fired towards Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: US says Iranian radar sites hit in Goruk and Qeshm Island
item.description: The US military released footage showing what they say are military strikes on Iranian radar sites.

item.title: Israeli soldier shoots Palestinian baby dead near Hebron
item.description: An Israeli soldier has shot and killed seven-month-old Palestinian infant Sam Abu Haikal.

item.title: Iran war live: Iranian missiles target Kuwait, Bahrain after US-Iran clash
item.description: Israel kills two Lebanese army officers, one soldier, and issues more forced displacement orders for southern Lebanon.

item.title: Trump makes pitch to farmers hard-hit by tariffs, high prices in Wisconsin
item.description: Trump seeks to shore up support among rural voters hard-hit by tariffs, economic fallout of war with Iran.

item.title: Iran footballers issued US visas for World Cup, says White House
item.description: Iran players get visas 10 days before their opening ‌World Cup match against New Zealand in Los Angeles on June 15.

item.title: Trump hails jobs surge, says Iran talks ‘going well’
item.description: Trump hailed jobs growth before pivoting to Iran, saying negotiations with Tehran "seem to be going quite well".

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
item.description: The US military says it struck Iranian drones and radar sites. Tehran responds by targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Lebanon says three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
item.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

item.title: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
item.description: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.
